content.readme:
Anatomy

A Claude skill that explains an idea by building it as a real, working object.
Also runs in Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex and MiniMax Code.
Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.

   

Quick start · Gallery · What it makes · Install · Usage · Examples · How it works · Limits

examples/raptor-engine, light theme, firing. The engine and stand are SVG; the plume is a WebGL shader in the same isometric camera.

--- Ask Claude for a figure that explains a technical idea, and Anatomy has it invent a physical thing whose working *is* the concept. A cache key that skips work when nothing changed becomes a pin-tumbler lock that only turns when every pin matches. One GPU context serving many canvases becomes a gantry plotter whose single print head visits 16 wells. Then Claude builds that thing out of dozens of small, solid, shaded parts, puts it in a framed card with a title, a hint and a live readout, makes it move calmly under the pointer and the keyboard, and checks its own work by zooming in on every joint. Every number the figure shows comes from the same small model that moves its parts. ## Quick start ```sh npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g ``` The CLI asks which agents to set up (Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex, MiniMax Code). To skip the question, add `-a claude-code`, `-a antigravity`, `-a opencode`, `-a codex`, or `-a minimax-code`. Then, in Claude Code: ```text /anatomy explain how a token bucket rate limiter works, interactive ``` For Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex, or MiniMax Code, target that agent: `-a antigravity`, `-a opencode`, `-a codex`, or `-a minimax-code`. Antigravity, OpenCode and MiniMax Code take the same `/anatomy` command; in Codex, type `$anatomy`. That's it. No API keys and nothing to `npm install`: the kit uses only Node's built-in modules. ## Gallery

content.readme:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) # huashu-art-motion · 艺术动画 让你的coding agent，把艺术风格写成会动的画。 36种艺术风格 · 9种解说语法 · 8种参数化片段 · 口播整片参考代码 ```sh npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion ``` [看动画](#动画样片) · [看风格](#看效果) · [开始使用](#里面有什么) · [下载完整样片](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)
## 动态 - 2026-10：[Open Design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design)（nexu-io 出品的开源 AI 设计工作区）的 [motion-design skill](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/main/skills/motion-design/SOURCES.md) 把 huashu-art-motion 列为设计来源之一，并在 [skills/huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/main/skills/huashu-art-motion) 收录了一份适配版，保留了 MIT 许可和上游出处。很高兴这套艺术动画的做法被另一个开源项目用起来，谢谢 Open Design 团队。也欢迎更多项目使用、反馈和贡献。 ## 动画样片 ### 核心案例：花叔闯进超级玛丽 把自己做成像素主角，跑完一整关。砖块、水管、关卡运动与转场用代码完成，人物用生成帧合成；下面直接截自65秒成片。 连吃蘑菇都得先选会员：OpenAI，还是Claude？选完Claude，星芒道具落下来，花叔变大。

连踩带踢 · 像素Sam与Dario客串敌人
钻进水管 · 金币密室与扫描线甩镜
这组展示的是成片效果；GIF无声、循环播放。[片段时间点与导出参数](assets/showcase/mario-clips.md)。 ### Clawd 博物馆奇妙夜 Claude Code 的像素吉祥物 Clawd 从保安电脑的终端里蹦出来，打着手电夜巡纽约大都会博物馆，再穿过中央公园去自然史博物馆，天亮前赶回来装成展品。98秒，16个场景，无口播，配乐也是代码合成的。 跳进梵高《麦田与柏树》：笔触方向取自原作的结构张量，Clawd被重画成厚涂。

霸王龙骨架 · 追手电光斑
天亮 · 装成展品眨一下眼
暗处是炭笔夜景，只有手电照到的地方显出颜色；入画的五幅（梵高、修拉、维米尔、伦勃朗、勒茨）都是大都会开放获取的CC0原作，按各自画家的笔法用代码重画。完整成片在[Releases](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)，[片段时间点与说明](assets/showcase/clawd-clips.md)。 ### 花叔穿越名画 画里真的会动。下面三段来自同一支穿越短片，场景用代码画，角色用生成帧合成。 日本桥上的一次水漂。

古埃及 · 圣甲虫
8-bit · 顶出金币
## 看效果 35段样片各取一帧：同一位少女、同一只橘白猫、同一张桌子，从公元前 40000 年的岩洞一路穿到 2026 年。每一段都在动：梵高的星空在转，马赛克的颜色从石块上流过去，水墨晕染把画面带进下一个时代。 注意：这 35 格用的是同一个构图，那是艺术史速通片的机制（风格在变、场景不变），不是这些风格的构图。做新题材要为题材重新构图，别把这间屋搬过去。 👉 [下载全风格样片（MP4）](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest) 长卷穿越片：一个人从左走到右，跨过边界的那一刻，世界和他自己的画风一起换（下图是收进仓库的 3 段示范：埃及壁画 → 莫奈《日本桥》→ 8-bit）： 8种解说语法各有一支可运行示范片（下图每镜取一帧）。此外还有第9种「讲解员式财经科普」，提供语法卡和需自备角色的整片代码快照。白板适合跟着口播画关系，Vox适合图形与信息拼贴： | | | |---|---| | Kurzgesagt：扁平无描边、尺度穿行 | Vox：剪报、红线、荧光笔 | | 白板：笔尖揭开线稿 | 3Blue1Brown：一个对象形变成下一个 | | Storytime：反应特写、笑点停顿 | 动态文字：主词砸进来 | | 发布会：光斑底、毛玻璃卡、大数字 | 财经图表：先轴、后数据、只标一件事 | --- ## 能做什么 | 你说 | 它做 | |---|---| | 「复刻这个动画」「拆一下这段」 | 先跑拆解脚本量出转场、节拍网格、每段运动热图，再按机制用代码复刻 | | 「做个梵高／莫奈／包豪斯那种的动画」 | 先设计一帧，再让它动起来；36张风格配方卡当起点 | | 「用我的口播做一段艺术动画」 | 镜头表 → 定风格 → 世界画布加镜头 → 输出一条画面轨 | | 「做一个人穿过一幅幅名画的片子」 | 长卷骨架：每个世界一个段文件，主角一路往右走，跨边界换画风，镜头只进不退 | | 「做解说视频的动画段」 | 按口播选语法，喂一份 JSON，出一段时长精确到帧的片段（横竖屏、可透明底） | | 「画面里要有人」 | 人交给生图模型出帧，代码负责合成、换帧和材质 | | 「配个乐、卡节奏」 | BPM 网格、动机换乐器、结尾音效序列，纯代码合成 | 交付前有一道数字验收：`qa.py` 量稳定、效率、动感、流畅及文字框景线索，再派一个没参与制作的 agent 只看成片挑问题；最后 `deliver.py` 一条命令交付——成片先过反 PPT 门禁（整片几乎没有镜头内快动作就红灯，不出片），过了才复制成片、写交付说明，说明里的事实由脚本写。 --- ## 里面有什么 | | 数量 | |---|---| | 艺术风格配方卡（参数、母题动作、签名转场、当前短板） | 53张，`references/风格配方/`；其中 38–55 是按原作锚定重做的研究配方（含敦煌壁画） | | 对应的场景代码 | 53个，`scripts/engine/scenes/` | | 解说动画语法卡 | 9份；其中8种附示范片、参数化片段与示例spec | | 口播整片参考代码 | 混合风格、白板、Vox、讲解员；需自备部分素材，详见目录README | | 长卷穿越片示范（骨架＋3 段＋角色帧库） | 1 支，`scripts/engine/demos/long_scroll/` | | 版面审计与压测（出界／叠字／字太小、竖屏／超长／英文变体、示例回归） | `render.py --audit`、`scripts/clip_lint.py`、`scripts/analyze/stress_clip.py`、`regress_clips.py` | | 转场 | 艺术风格签名转场与解说转场，包含淡入、硬切和纸面转场 | | 绘画与动画库（笔刷、渲染器、后期、骨架、镜头、图表、排版……） | 17 个，`scripts/engine/lib/` | | 方法文档（拆解、机制、一帧先行、纯代码绘制、节奏配乐、角色、长卷……） | 核心12篇

basic_info.name: dsh-ops
basic_info.description: A toolkit for low-level operations in DSH, designed to reduce token usage and task execution time / DSH 底层操作工具插件，旨在减少 Token 消耗与任务耗时

content.readme:
中文 | English

# dsh-ops 以提高token效率为目的，提供新增的ops系列工具并隐藏部分官方工具为方案的插件，低改动面，低侵入性，与其他插件广泛兼容。 - （仅 Windows）启用与 dsh 原生 bash 行为一致的 ops_bash；启用模式行时用它替换官方 pwsh，兼容模式则保留官方工具 - 四个预设模式行分别增强内置 Minimal/Standard/PTC/Cordis preset：Standard 与 Cordis 替换官方 read/glob/grep，PTC 提供类型化 SDK，Minimal 只替换 Windows shell；discovery 行启用时其会话始终获得动态加载入口；兼容模式（默认关闭）可保留全部官方工具 - 启用 DSH 预留的 `tools_addition` 动态工具加载，并提供渐进式纰漏的工具，作为高级功能（如pdf、word读取、超多文件批量修改）的加载平台，大大减少常见特定场景的token消耗量，且不会导致系统提示词膨胀 - 为 Native 模式提供返回紧凑、带行号和更好错误回馈的工具以遏制报错循环，减少调用轮次 - 为 PTC 模式提供一些返回结构化 JSON 值的工具以降低 ai 在 ptc 模式下编写 TypeScript 代码的token总量和心智负担 - PTC SDK 目录包含 18 个 API：15 个文件/文档工具，加批处理、结果引用和加载器。

   

左：deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017在各harness的跑分与开销
右：ops在自用benchmark上取得的的成绩。完整benchmark将随后续更新发布
dsh-ops团队将致力于持续优化dsh的token效率，以更低的成本更好地完成同样的任务

## 安装、更新、卸载 ### 官方插件市场 在目标 DSH 应用的插件市场中输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-ops`**，选择自定义地址，输入 `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/repository/npm/`，安装后选择启用。目前不推荐用npmmirror安装，有bug。 当然，如果你确定可以连接 npm 官方源那就选择官方源，如果你不确定那就按教程操作。 ![在插件市场中选择自定义地址并填入华为云 npm 镜像](docs/assets/marketplace-huaweicloud-mirror.png) ### npm 一键安装 #### 安装方法 ```console npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui ``` 必须显式选择目标 profile；`tui` 映射到 **dsh-TUI 产品的 `dsh-tui` profile**，不是旧的 `tui` 目录。请先初始化目标应用。该入口委托官方 DSH CLI 安装，不另写一套 profile 锁与回滚逻辑。 桌面端必须使用桌面应用自带的 CLI；默认探测 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。安装在其它位置时加 `--dsh-cli "<安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`。Web/TUI 需要可用的 DSH CLI，可同样显式指定。 安装或卸载时可加 `--dry-run` 预演。它按指定路径或 `PATH`（Windows 同时使用 `PATHEXT`）解析 CLI，检查文件、POSIX 执行权限及通过 Node 启动的入口文件，并在预演时同样拒绝不安全的 Windows 命令脚本路径；检查失败返回非零。预演只打印计划，不启动 CLI、不修改 profile。成功表示这些静态检查已通过，不保证所选程序的身份、版本、profile 兼容性或后续安装结果。 也可以直接使用官方命令： ```console dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops "<桌面安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops ``` 普通 DSH CLI 不能管理保留的 `desktop` profile；不要把它与桌面自带入口混淆。 #### 更新方法 宿主兼容范围明确声明为 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2**。 组件图标导出、profile 刷新及配置/schema 检查见 [宿主兼容范围与展示元数据](docs/使用指南.md#宿主兼容范围与展示元数据)。 重新运行相同的 `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`，或用官方 CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`。按应用提示重载；替换已加载代码时重启应用。 #### 卸载与查看状态 ```console npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop ``` 把 `desktop` 换成 `web` 或 `tui` 即可。也可在市场卸载，或执行官方 `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`。插件依赖（含 Windows bash 可选载荷）随 profile 管理；单独 provision 的 Bash 用 `dsh-ops bash-runtime remove --yes` 移除，不误删系统 shell、其它 profile 的副本或包管理器共享缓存。 旧版显式 provision 的 `/dsh-ops/` 文件（provision 的 shell，以及早期版本可 provision 的 FastCtx 运行时）需单独清理：`npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`。已移除的后台组件留下的 `~/.fastctx/` 状态默认不删；需要时显式加 `--purge-fastctx`。 组件 bundle 现为八行：`mode-minimal`、`mode-standard`、`mode-ptc`、`mode-cordis`、`discovery`、`compat`、`panel`、`tui`。旧的 `shell`、`file`、`ptc`、`hide-official` 行已移除，请删除为它们保存的 profile 覆盖，并按需重设模式开关。 原 `dsh-ops/background` 组件（FastCtx 后台任务）已移除。仍保留该行的 profile 照常加载：该行不发布任何工具，只记录一条警告，可直接删除。 ## 可选 OPS 只读侧栏 在 dsh-TUI 中启用 `dsh-ops/tui` 行并重启，即可添加 OPS 侧栏；不抢焦点，不执行额外工具调用。没有 `tuiPanels` 的宿主仅让该可选行等待，不影响其它组件。见 [侧栏说明](docs/tui-panel.zh.md)。 聚焦后可用 `f` 筛选、`n`/`p` 本地翻页、`a` 确认跨会话提醒；只浏览有界保留元数据，不拉取结果分页。 ## 文档 - [第三方预设集成接口](docs/集成接口.md) · [外部 Native 提供者](docs/外部工具提供者.md) · [作用域诊断](docs/集成诊断.md) - [使用指南](docs/使用指南.md) · [常见问题](docs/常见问题.md) · [组件参考](docs/组件参考.md) · [配置参考](docs/配置参考.md) - [PTC 设计与使用](docs/native-ptc.md) · [手动验证](docs/手动验收.md) - [贡献指南](docs/贡献指南.md) · [路线图](docs/路线图.md) · [变更日志](docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [溯源记录](docs/PROVENANCE.md) ## 许可证 当前

content.readme:
Answer me with HTML

Super Fast  |  ASD-STE100  |  Explainer Videos  |  One File, Offline

An agent skill. Ask a hard question, get a page you can actually read instead of a wall of text.
The model writes about 1/8 of the tokens it would need to hand-write the HTML.

Website · Install · Examples · Videos · Always-on mode · Reference · 简体中文

Once installed, ask questions the way you always do: ``` > Explain the TCP three-way handshake > Map out how the modules in this repo fit together > Redis or Memcached for our cache? ``` The agent writes a short Markdown draft and hands it to the CLI that ships with the skill. About 50 ms later you have a page: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d3063a28-5dfd-4c44-a562-be901c49b249

24-second demo. Turn the sound on for the music.

## Why not just ask for HTML? You can. Models write decent HTML now. But most of what they write is not content. We counted the tokens in 9 pages the model wrote by hand, 4,893 tokens on average: | Part of the page | Share | With this skill | | :--- | ---: | :--- | | SVG diagrams: coordinates and paths | 47% | The CLI writes it | | CSS | 15% | The CLI writes it | | HTML tags | 17% | The CLI writes it | | Text | 21% | The model writes it, as Markdown | With this skill the model writes only a Markdown draft. For the same questions that was 612 tokens on average, **about 1/8 of the hand-written HTML**. Less to write means less to wait for (3 topics × 3 runs, medians, Claude Sonnet 5.5, a plain Claude Code setup): | | Ask for HTML directly | Answer me with HTML | | | :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- | | Tokens the model writes | 4,893 | **612** | **8× fewer** | | Time | 31 s | **12 s** | **2.6× faster** |

The same question, the same model, answered both ways. Both pages are usable.

The token counts are saved in [bench/corpus/tokens.json](bench/corpus/tokens.json), so `node bench/corpus.mjs` gives the same numbers every time. The pages themselves are a [download](https://github.com/QingYunA/answer-me-with-html/releases/download/v0.4.14/bench-corpus-2026-10-07.zip). The bill drops less than the writing, about 15% here, because every turn also reads the system prompt, your question and the conversation, with or without the skill. See [where the cost goes](bench/README.md#where-the-cost-goes). Explainer videos save even more: about 18× fewer output tokens and 12× faster in [a small test](bench/README.md#explainer-videos). ## Install You need [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step. The CLI is bundled inside the skill. No Node.js yet? With the recommended install below, your agent asks you and then installs it. ### Let your agent i

content.readme: # DS Bot English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-v0.2_preview-blue) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-4D6BFE) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache_2.0-green) DS Bot is a bot plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). It turns DSH into bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them. ![Say one sentence to Chief, and it sets up the bots and the group chat](docs/images/team.png) ## Install **Desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)** The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you don't need to install DSH first. Download it from [Releases](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases): - Windows (x64): `DeepSeek-Bot--win-x64.exe`. Run it; it installs for your user only, without administrator rights. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", select **More info** → **Run anyway**. - macOS: `DeepSeek-Bot--mac-arm64.zip` for an Apple chip, `DeepSeek-Bot--mac-x64.zip` for Intel. Safari unzips it by itself; drag **DeepSeek Bot** into **Applications** and open it. When macOS says it cannot check the app, open **System Settings** → **Privacy & Security** and select **Open Anyway**. - Linux (x64): `DeepSeek-Bot--linux-x86_64.AppImage` runs on every distribution — make it executable and open it. It mounts through FUSE 2, which you may need to install first (`sudo apt install libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04+, `sudo dnf install fuse-libs` on Fedora, `sudo pacman -S fuse2` on Arch). On Ubuntu 24.04 and later an AppImage can refuse to start (Ubuntu restricts the sandbox it needs); the `DeepSeek-Bot--linux-amd64.deb` on Debian/Ubuntu does not have this problem and adds a menu entry. At the first start the app asks where to keep its data and the Bots' files, and offers to copy a Bot team from your DSH (it only reads your DSH). Set up a model in its settings. The Windows app and the Linux AppImage update themselves; the macOS app and the Linux deb tell you when a new version is ready to download. **As a plugin in DSH** First install DSH and set up at least one model in it. DS Bot uses the models from DSH. **DSH Desktop (Windows, macOS)** 1. In the sidebar, select **Plugins** → **Add plugin**. 2. In **Package name or address**, enter `ds-bot`. In mainland China, set **Registry** to **Mainland China mirror**. 3. Select **Install**, then **Enable now**. If DSH says the change takes effect at the next start, quit DSH completely and open it again. If npm is not reachable, in step 2 you can also enter the full path of `ds-bot-0.2.1.tgz` downloaded from [Releases](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot/releases), or `github:Fei2411/DS-Bot#v0.2.1&path:/ds-bot` (needs Git). DS Bot 0.2.1 and earlier cannot update themselves in DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 or later: on the Plugins page, remove `ds-bot` and add `ds-bot` again. The Bots, chats and memory stay. **DSH Web (Windows, macOS, Linux)** Needs Node.js `22.19` or later, and pnpm. ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add ds-bot npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 web ``` **Docker (NAS, Linux server)** The [`docker/`](docker/) directory builds an image with DSH Web and DS Bot, for a NAS or any always-on machine. CI is configured to publish a prebuilt linux/amd64 image to GHCR. The container is the Bots' sandbox: they get full access to what you mount into it, and nothing else. See [`docker/README.md`](docker/README.md). ## Setup I strongly recommend that you set up your other bots and group chats by just talking to a bot. ### Web search DS Bot selects its `auto` search provider for the whole profile. If you disable `web-search-auto`, also select another registered search provider in that profile. See [Web search](ds-bot/README.md#web-search) and the [recovery steps](docs/known-issues.md#web-search-fails-everywhere-after-turning-off-web-search-auto). ## Features ### Bot You can do all your talking and work with one bot, in one window. You don't need to worry about the context behind it. The bot's details page shows its info, and there you can pick the model you want it to use. You can switch models at any time, but I still recommend that you keep one model for a bot for a long time, and switch only when you really need to. Bots also have memory. A bot remembers what you like and uses it in later work. You can manage its memory on the bot's details page, or just tell the bot. ![Bot details: model, memory, usage](docs/images/details.png) ### Main bot The main bot is your chief. It has very high rights: it manages the other bots and the group chats. The first time you open DS Bot, there is already a main bot called Chief. Talk to it, and it walks you through the setup. In short: have a question?

# dsh-purge Community **让 AI 更专注地辅助你的学习与动手实验。** 给 DeepSeek Harness 的自托管控件（俗称「破甲」插件）· 80 条宿主补丁 · 25 层状态自检 · 左侧栏整页设置 [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge?label=release)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/releases) [![Checks](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge/actions/workflows/community.yml) 当前版本 **1.6.60** · 适配 **DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**（rc.1 / rc.2 同样通过） · [English](docs/README.en.md) 1.6.56 改善状态页卡顿，避免缓存旧宿主证据；读取失败不再误报未安装，并修复深色主题按钮对比度。[发行说明](docs/releases/1.6.56.md) · [市场安装与迁移指南](docs/MARKET-MIGRATION.md)。 **原项目与作者**：基于 [小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。
--- ## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio） 破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。 配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH： - **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放； - **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起； - 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务； - 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。 **组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。 **仓库**：[kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio) · **下载**：[最新 Releases](https://github.com/kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-qwen-studio/releases/latest) · - **看清楚状态**：安装、补丁、注入到底有没有就绪，一条命令或一屏面板给结论； - **少一些往返**：把反复出现的确认与打断，收敛成一次设置； - **随时能回去**：应用、回滚、开关都留记录，操作前自动快照； - **方便做实验**：提示词、规则、预设集中管理，改坏了能撤。 目标很简单：**让助手更连贯地配合你的学习与动手实验**，而不是每做一步都先停下来问一句。 dry-run，仍失败时提交脱敏诊断行即可。见 [下载排查说明](docs/maintenance-issue-52.md)。不会自动修改代理或重启 DSH。 ### 让不同预设保留自己的提示词 1.6.40 新增 `excludePresets`：默认空列表，保持原有行为；可将 `roleplay`、`minimal` 等预设排除在 Purge DSH 版本的入口文字可能不同；第三方 `dsh-market` 也可能有额外的筛选与迁移限制。已有旧包时请使用方式三。[官方市场说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.zh.md) ### 方式二：DSH 官方 CLI（首次安装） 聊天模式与助手模式 | 模式 | 适合什么场景 | | --- | --- | | 聊天模式 | 人格对话、群聊参与、看图、表情、搜索与主动聊天 | | 助手模式 | 从微信交办任务，使用已授权的 DSH 工具与技能 | 助手模式需要配置管理员身份，并为目标聊天明确授权。 两种模式分别保留设置与上下文。 配置步骤和使用示例见 [远程助手教程](docs/ASSISTANT_REMOTE.md)。 ## 使用教程 | 我想做什么 | 教程 | | --- | --- | | 熟悉界面、为聊天选择人格与模式 | [界面与聊天设置](docs/UI_LAYOUT.md) | | 通过微信交办任务 | [远程助手](docs/ASSISTANT_REMOTE.md) | | 为指定聊天分配工具与技能 | [能力授权](docs/DSH_CHAT_ACCESS.md) | | 接收附件、回传任务成果 | [文件收发](docs/FILE_TRANSFER.md) | | 添加和管理表情 | [表情管理](docs/STICKER_MANAGER.md) | | 接入 dsh-meme 图库 | [图库接入](docs/DSH_MEME.md) | | 安装鱼的记事本 | [记事本插件](docs/FISH_NOTEBOOK.md) | | 了解群友记忆 | [群友记忆](docs/MEMBER_MEMORY.md) | | 更换安装位置、迁移数据 | [数据位置与迁移](docs/DATA_STORAGE.md) | ## 插件安装 在“能力 → 能力目录”拖入 WeChatAgent API v2 插件 ZIP： 1. 核对插件名称、版本与权限。 2. 安装插件。 3. 配置参数，并选择允许使用的聊天。 4. 启用插件。 安装后默认关闭。更新与卸载的数据保留规则， 以插件说明和界面提示为准。 WeChatAgent 插件与 DSH 插件分别管理，安装包不通用。 [插件开发规范](docs/PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md) · [聊天小便签示例](examples/plugins/chat-notes/) · [鱼的记事本](docs/FISH_NOTEBOOK.md) ## 常见问题 ### 自建搜索后端总是超时怎么办？ 自建 Search API 或响应较慢的搜索后端，可在“能力 → 联网与阅读 → 搜索次数、缓存与超时”将搜索超时调为 30–60 秒；配置 `wechat.search.timeoutMs` 的单位为毫秒，例如 `45000`。默认仍为 20 秒，已有设置不变。若报 `native_timeout`，还需检查 DSH 与后端自身的时限；外层等待不会延长内部超时。详见 [联网搜索说明](docs/WEB_SEARCH.md)。 ### 添加好友后为什么没有回复？ 检查服务是否启动、好友是否加入允许范围， 以及微信和 DSH 是否连接正常。 ### 群聊为什么有时不回复？ 检查本群的唤醒方式和回复频率设置。 自然参与模式下，模型也可能选择沉默。 ### DSH 插件启用后为什么仍连接不上？ 确认添加的是当前安装位置提供的插件， 并从托盘完整退出、重新打开 DSH。 进一步检查“设置 → 诊断”中的连接结果。 ### 关闭窗口后为什么还在运行？ 窗口“×”会收起到托盘。 需要停止后台并关闭程序时，请使用“退出应用”。 ### 升级会丢失数据吗？ 同位置升级沿用已有数据位置。 更换位置时，需要核对迁移来源与目标。 详细说明见 [数据迁移](docs/DATA_STORAGE.md)。 ### 为什么看不到表情包 先确认电脑微信是否已有该表情的完整副本。本机缺失且下载开关关闭时，日志会显示 `STICKER_CDN_DISABLED`。如允许从腾讯补充下载，在“表情包 → 来源和搜索 → 缺失资源下载与版本兼容”开启“允许从腾讯下载缺失的表情包”，保存后重试；已有本机副本仍可直接读取。 ## 升级与更新 升级前： 1. 停止助手服务。 2. 完整退出 WeChatAgent、DSH 和匹配微信。 3. 核对当前数据位置。 安装新版后，按发布说明准备连接配置并重新打开 DSH。 [查看发布说明](RELEASE_NOTES.md) · [下载新版](https://github.com/sourcepro5/WeChatAgent/releases) ## 开发与构建 开发前请了解目录职责、外部组件和构建前置条件。 - [项目目录](docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md) - [构建说明](docs/INSTALLER_RELEASE.md#构建) - [插件开发](docs/PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md) ## 数据与隐私 WeChatAgent 的配置、缓存和运行数据保存在本机。 DSH 独立管理自己的会话与附件。 启用模型后，相关聊天内容和附件会交给所选模型服务处理。 分享日志、截图或配置前，请移除账号、凭据和聊天隐私信息。 ## 许可证与致谢 本项目包含不同来源和许可的组件， 具体范围见 [LICENSES.md](LICENSES.md)。 感谢相关上游项目及贡献者。 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/sourcepro5/WeChatAgent/issues) 反馈问题。提交时请附上版本、复现步骤和脱敏日志。 微信语音可通过单独分发的“语音识别 API”插件转写，再交给当前聊天模型。接口、密钥及模型默认留空，不默认安装或启用；说明见 [语音 API 转写](docs/VOICE_INPUT.md)。插件宿主校验使用 `npm run plugin:check`；源码与安装器构建会检查权限、能力声明及第一方 ZIP 与源码的一致性。

content.readme:
**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) # huashu-motion > *「一键直出商业级产品宣传片。」* [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Agent Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent%20Skills-Standard-green)](https://agentskills.io) [![Runtime](https://img.shields.io/badge/Runtime-Claude%20Code%20·%20Codex%20·%20WorkBuddy%20·%20Grok%20Bot%20·%20Muse%20·%20Dots-blueviolet)](#安装) **让你的agent做动画、作曲，指着画面改。** 跟Claude Code、Codex这些agent说一句「给我的产品做个30秒的发布片」，
它会先读你的产品，给你三个方向挑，写出整支片子，自己写谱配乐，
然后在浏览器里打开一个编辑器等你。哪里不满意，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么，它就只改那一处。 ```sh npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-motion ``` [看效果](#看效果) · [安装](#安装) · [能做什么](#能做什么) · [怎么做到的](#怎么做到的) · [背后的故事](#背后的故事)
--- ## 看效果 这篇README里的每一段动画都是huashu-motion做的。上面那段取自它给自己做的53秒发布片，👉 [下载完整发布片（MP4，带声音）](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion/releases/latest)，下面Grok Bot（非官方）、huashu-design、DeepSeek、Claude Duet（非官方）这几支的完整版也在同一个页面。 ### 指着画面改 按C，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么。评论发过去的时候带着时间点、场景、点中的元素和它在源码里的位置，agent先把那一帧和你点的那一小块截图放大看一眼，再只改那一处，改完回一句人话，预览停在原来的位置刷新。每一版都留着，⌘Z随时撤回；标题、数字、颜色、停留时长这些会变成编辑器右边的输入框，自己改，不用等agent。 （这段里的编辑器和终端是照真实界面重建的，代码细节是示意；评论是真实提过的意见。） ### 先写谱，再拍片 做发布片用的是作曲家模式：agent按节奏单先写一份谱（ABC记谱法，纯文本的乐谱），谱里的标记对齐每个场景，再由三角钢琴、弦乐和鼓组的采样演奏出来（真乐器采样要先跑一次`om samples build`，不跑就用合成音色）；画面上每个东西落地的那一帧，再配一个音效。配乐全部在本机现场生成，不调用任何收费接口。 ### 一天，二十支 16个镜头，来自同一天做的七支片子，按拍子切。 Grok Bot（粉丝自制，非官方）· 30秒：傍晚交代任务，夜里几个agent各干各的，早上7点手机上收到汇报。这段是汇报一张张送往Chief of Staff的那几拍。

huashu-design 3.0 · 一句提示词钉住不动，背后的风格按拍子换
小猫补光灯Pro · 八种补光色，一拍换一种
### 不依赖Opus：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash也能做 这支22秒的动效片，是把Claude Code背后的模型换成DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（1017版）做的。中间我给了三轮意见（比如加上DeepSeek的鲸鱼logo、删掉几个镜头），带配乐和音效，前后不到半小时，按当时的价格花了1块9毛5（缓存命中率99.4%）。统一的配色、贯穿全片的那颗圆点、卡在124BPM上的配乐，是skill带出来的，我一句都没提过。方法写进了skill，便宜的模型也能拍出像样的片子。 ### Claude Duet（粉丝自制，非官方）：一次给足需求，全程没找我确认 Anthropic发布Claude Duet当天做的，29秒英文版。像素小人Claude Code在终端里等你敲键，变形成Duet以后主动来找你，你睡着了它接着干。完整版在[Release页面](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion/releases/latest)。 --- ## 样片是怎么做出来的 很多人问这些样片用的是什么提示词。下面是我当时的原话，一字没改，语音输入的错字也留着；本机路径和截图换成了方括号里的说明，跟这支片无关的话删掉了，用……标出；圆括号里是我补的上下文。 可以看出来，效果不全来自第一句话：有的片子我一次把需求说清楚，就放手让它做；有的片子我盯着改了好几轮。一句话也能出片，想到这个水准，要么第一句给足，要么后面有人当导演。
Claude Duet（非官方）· 一份需求、两条追加，中间没有修改意见 > anthropic刚刚发布了claude duet，我希望你帮我充分调研信息，然后帮我做三个版本的视频 /huashu-motion > 版本一：16：9 英文版本，30秒以内 > 版本二：16：9 中文版本 我希望除了品牌信息外，主要元素都是中文 ，30秒以内 > 版本三：带中文口播，2：3比例，主要界面内容包含官方英文，以及我们制作的中文版本，目标是发在抖音上给用户介绍Claude duet，1分钟以内 > > 这三个版本我们都需要体现三个方面，但你可以通过不同的方式强调和和体现： > 1、Claude duet和Claude code这种coding agent之间的区别 > 2、目前的使用门槛：大致是pro、max会员可以用上，但是需要申请waitlist > 3、ChatGPT dots、muse、grok bot这三个都是personal agent，一定程度上可以认为面对前面三个personal agent，claude选择了claude duet出击。[一张Claude Code像素形象的截图] 这是Claude code原本的形象，我觉得你可以用一个比较视觉化的，动效出色的语言比较有趣的去表达这件事。 > 三个版本都需要被认为超过了90分才能算制作完成。以及第三个版本我们做完后，你制作封面和标题简介，然后发到抖音和视频号 > > 除了huashu-motion之外，你也可以使用 /huashu-video-pipeline /huashu-art-motion 这两个skill辅助你完成内容创作 随后追加了两条，一条在11秒后，一条在5分钟后： > 不需要找我做任何确认，请完全独立执行 > 用更多的动效和视觉隐喻去表达，而非用过多的字幕与语言。 > > 抖音版本里可以用x截图之类的方式辅助口播去表达anthropic刚刚发布了这个新产品 之后除了交代做完发到X，没再给过意见。方向是agent自己选的，「过了90分」由另开的评审agent按评分标准打分，英文版改到第9版拿到91分才交。
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash动效片 · 一句话＋三轮意见，全程不到半小时 > 用 /huashu-motion skill尽情展示你的动效制作能力，不要关心传达什么，做尽可能多的快切和不同类型的动效展示，30秒以内。最后展示这个动画是由DeepSeek v4.1 flash 1017制作的即可 做的过程中： > 哦对，开头也可以加一点DeepSeek的logo、鲸鱼，然后快速转动画 看第1版： > [截了一帧] 这部分画面动效就去掉吧，我觉得很差，不需要展示。以及最后的结尾也长了一些。我觉得爆点可以更早开始！ 看第2版： > [又截了两帧] 这两个动效画面也可以去掉，很差 之后就没再改过，最后交的是第8版。
Grok Bot粉丝片 · 一句话＋选方向＋一轮意见 > 我们去给马斯克新推出的personal agent：grok bot做一个产品发布的宣传片 agent给了三个方向（团队上线、夜班、八只手），推荐用夜班的故事做骨架、中间插一段色块快切、电脑窗口用真界面。我回： > 没问题，按你的推荐结构 看第4版： > 整体不错，但是第一帧开场的效果我觉得很差，还不如核心聚焦在typing呢 看第6版： > 非常非常棒！！我觉得我们的huashu-motion比昨晚又强了很多很多。……
huashu-design 3.0发布片 · 一句话＋选方向，第一版就过了，后来又往上提 > 你再打开两个fanbox窗口，分别去做

- [许可证](#许可证) · [致谢与数据来源](#致谢与数据来源) · [贡献](#贡献)

## 简介

「卫戍协议：盟约」是自走棋 + 塔防：休整期在调度中心招募干员、摆阵、配装备，作战期干员自动部署，迎击从红门涌来的敌人，漏过去的敌人扣目标生命值。本项目在浏览器里复刻了这一玩法，规则和数值尽量对照官方数据表与 PRTS 核对。

- **独立模拟**（单人）与**同盟模拟**（1–4 人**合作**，没有 PvP；空位可以加 AI 队友）。
- 服务器是一个 Node.js 程序，**战斗在各玩家的浏览器里模拟**（和官方一样），服务器只管经济与回合，一台低功耗小主机就能开服。
- 当前版本 0.3.3：0.3.2 的热修复，修正第一期商店装备空栏与跨版本装备图标缓存；第一期上／下半也允许满整备区互换（维护者决定的有意偏差）。默认仍提供四个官方版本，详见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 功能一览

- **完整的一局**：确认本局信息 → 策略轮选（40 名策略）→ 14 回合 → 结算称号；险境及以上满足条件时进入第 15 回合「隐秘核心」。
- **4 种难度**：标准 / 险境 / 绝境 / 终极，独立与同盟各一套参数，均取自官方数据。
- **休整期**：招募、刷新、冻结、升级调度中心；整备区与临时整备区；从整备区拖到棋盘部署，用**方向轮盘**选择朝向。同盟模拟的卡池共用。
- **晋升精锐**：3 名同名干员自动合成精锐，并获得一次高一阶的免费招募。
- **干员与调配**：112 名可招募干员（+ 精锐）及其技能、天赋和特质；开局前可以为每名干员选择携带的技能（283 个技能全部手工实现）和精锐的模组，调配页也可以换成活动「物资调配处」那样的卡片视图。
- **盟约与层数**：23 个盟约（8 个势力核心盟约 + 附加盟约），层数整局保留，每个盟约最多 999 层。

content.readme:
# Gr8r Studio

A calm, structured project management workspace: home dashboard, inbox, my tasks, projects with
board / list / table / calendar / timeline / files views, members, teams, activity and settings.

Built with plain JavaScript ES modules and CSS, bundled by [Vite](https://vite.dev). There is no
UI framework and no runtime dependency.

![Gr8r Studio home dashboard](docs/preview.png)

## Getting started

Requires Node.js 18 or newer (`.nvmrc` pins 22).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev       # http://localhost:5173 with hot reload
npm run build     # production build in dist/
npm run preview   # serve the production build locally
npm run lint      # ESLint
npm run format    # Prettier
```

## Project structure

```
index.html              HTML entry; loads src/main.js
public/favicon.svg      brand mark
vite.config.js          Vite config, including the Lucide icon-subset plugin
eslint.config.js        lint rules (ESLint flat config); formatting by Prettier (.prettierrc.json)
.github/workflows/      CI: lint, format check, build
docs/preview.png        README screenshot
src/
  main.js               entry: imports styles and modules, then boots the app
  styles/
    index.css           imports every stylesheet in cascade order
    tokens.css          colours, spacing, type, radius, the shared --gutter
    base.css  components.css  shell.css  panels.css  overlays.css  states.css  motion.css  responsive.css
    views/              list, board, table, calendar, timeline, projects & files
    pages/              settings, auth & onboarding
  core/                 utilities, constants, icons, store (state + lookups), theme
  data/seed.js          demo workspace data
  ui/                   shared render helpers, toasts, the select dropdown
  shell/                render loop and router, sidebar/topbar layout, skeletons, view engine
  components/           task list renderer
  pages/                one module per route
  views/                project views: board, table, calendar, timeline, files, overview
  overlays/             task drawer, modals, popovers, context menu, command palette
  features/             teams, subtasks, archive (rendering)
  actions/              user actions, event wiring, keyboard shortcuts, drag and drop
```

### Layers

Dependencies point downward:

1. `core/` and `data/` depend on nothing else in the app.
2. `ui/`, `shell/`, `components/`, `pages/`, `views/`, `overlays/` and `features/` render HTML from state.
3. `actions/` change state and re-render. Each action module registers its handlers on the
   shared action table (`A`) when it loads, so `main.js` imports them after `actions/actions.js`.

## Conventions

- **Rendering:** each page or view is a function that returns an HTML string from the store
  (`S`). `render()` rebuilds the shell and keeps focus and scroll positions.
- **Interactions:** elements declare `data-a="actionName"`. `actions/events.js` delegates the
  click to `A.actionName`. Inputs use `data-in`, blur handlers use `data-blur`.
- **Layout:** every page edge uses `var(--gutter)`, so the breadcrumb, page header, toolbar,
  list, table and board start on the same line.
- **Dropdowns:** write a normal `<select class="select">`. `ui/select.js` renders it as the
  design-system menu and keeps the native element as the source of truth.
- **Icons:** call `ic('name')` with any [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icon name. The
  `virtual:icons` plugin bundles only the icons the source uses.

## Continuous integration

Every push and pull request runs lint, the format check and a production build
(`.github/workflows/ci.yml`).

## Deploy

`vercel.json` builds with Vite and serves `dist/`.

Review shows what to fix before sending: subject, preview text, unsubscribe link, Gmail's 100 KB clip, postal address, sender. On MailCheap Cloud, a newsletter without a domain sends from its own shared address, `hello@.mailcheap.ai`. - **Deliverability protections**, built in: - sending pace: contacts the account never emailed go out in steps, a random 2% first, then 5% more, then the rest, 30 minutes apart while their bounces and complaints stay low. # PHP Version Checker

Get a version-based PHP2Shell warning from a website's PHP headers or local installation.

To install both skills, ask Codex:

```text
$skill-installer install both skills from https://github.com/openai/php2shell-checker
```

Use [phpcheck-server](skills/phpcheck-server/SKILL.md) when you have server
access, or [phpcheck-url](skills/phpcheck-url/SKILL.md) when you only have a URL:

```text
$phpcheck-url check https://example.com
```

```text
$phpcheck-server check the PHP version serving my site
```

## Run directly

Check a website:

```sh
node phpcheck.js "https://example.com"
```

## Results

| Result | Exit code | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OK` | `0` | Advertised version meets an upstream fixed release. |
| `POTENTIALLY VULNERABLE` | `1` | Advertised version is in an affected range. |
| `UNKNOWN` | `3` | Missing or unrecognized version, prerelease, or failed check. |

Use `--json` for machine-readable output. `patch_status` is `ok`,
`potentially_vulnerable` or `unknown`. Invalid arguments exit with code `2`.

Versions below a listed upstream fix return `potentially_vulnerable` and
exit `1`. PHP 5.4–5.6, 7.0–7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 also return this warning, even
with a higher patch number such as 8.1.35.

## URL checks

URL mode reads `X-Powered-By` and `Server`, sends `HEAD`, and falls back to
`GET` only when `HEAD` returns 405 or 501. It does not follow redirects or
inspect response bodies. Missing or hidden PHP headers return `UNKNOWN`.

The upstream fixed releases are 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12, from the
[October 21 PHP advisory](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5).
HTTP headers cannot tell whether the version contains a backported fix. Even `OK`
only describes the advertised version - it doesn't verify the installation!
The checker does not send exploit probes.

## Contributing

OpenAI is not accepting external code contributions to this project. Bug
reports and non-code feedback are welcome through GitHub issues. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

content.readme:
# Roast Room

![The Roast Room](docs/room.jpg)

Bring a hard business decision and a council of AI advisors argues it out, then hands you a scored verdict and a one-click PDF. Twelve advisors ship with it, each built from that person's public work: their letters, essays, talks, and videos. For each question, the Chair recommends who should sit on the council and you confirm. The council runs in Claude Code, and a small local web app shows them around a table talking it through. Want someone else at the table? Type `/newroaster` and a name, and Claude builds that advisor the same way.

| Seat | Pillar | The question they own |
|---|---|---|
| Jeff Bezos | Strategy and decisions | Is this the right bet, and how reversible is it? |
| Paul Graham | Product and startups | Do people actually want this, and is it growing? |
| Alex Hormozi | Offers, pricing, and sales | Will people pay, how much, and how do we close? |
| Gary Vaynerchuk | Marketing and attention | Where does the attention come from? |
| Dan Martell | People, hiring, and founder time | Who does this, and what does it cost your calendar? |
| Gino Wickman | Operations and scaling | Can the business run this without you holding it together? |
| Warren Buffett | Money and capital | What does it do to cash, risk, and long-term value? |

Those seven are the **default board**. Five more advisors are on call, and the Chair brings them in when your question is in their lane:

| Seat | Pillar | The question they own |
|---|---|---|
| Naval Ravikant | Leverage and wealth | Does this build leverage and equity you own, or does it just rent out your time? |
| Codie Sanchez | Buying and owning small businesses | Should you build this, or buy something that already works? |
| Leila Hormozi | Leadership and scaling teams | Can your team and your leadership carry this, and who has to change? |
| Sara Blakely | Consumer product and brand from zero | Will customers love it enough to sell it for you, without outside money? |
| Elon Musk | First principles and execution speed | What is the real constraint here, and can we cut steps and build it faster? |

## What you need

- [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code). Your Claude plan covers it; no API key needed.
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 20 or newer, for the room. There's nothing to install beyond that.

## Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/nateherkai/roast-room.git
cd roast-room
```

Or open Claude Code anywhere and say: "Clone github.com/nateherkai/roast-room and start the room for me."

## Run a roast

1. Start the room: `npm start`, then open http://localhost:4730. Leave it open.
2. Open Claude Code in the same folder: `claude`
3. Type `/roast-room` and your decision.
4. Answer the Chair's questions, then watch the council argue it out in the room.
5. When the verdict lands, click **Download PDF**.

You also get a short verdict in Claude Code, and the full report lands in `sessions/<date>-<decision>/verdict.md`.

## What to put in your question

The council is only as good as what you give it. Include:

- **The decision** in one line.
- **Your options.** Two or three. "Keep doing what I do now" counts.
- **Your numbers.** Revenue, cash, and team size.
- **Your limits.** Deadline, hours, and budget.
- **What success looks like**, and by when.
- **Which way you're leaning**, and why. The council tests your lean instead of agreeing with it.

Left something out? The Chair asks before the council starts. Example:

```
/roast-room I run a coaching business at $30k a month with 15 clients at $2,000 each.
Should I raise to $3,500 for everyone, raise for new clients only, or keep $2,000?
Close rate is about 50% and I have $40k in the bank. Success is $45k a month by March.
I'm leaning toward raising for everyone because I'm underpaid.
```

More ways to run it:

- `/roast-room --quick ...` seats four advisors for two rounds. Use it for smaller, reversible calls. It uses far less of your plan.
- `/roast-room --seats hormozi,buffett ...` seats only the advisors you name.
- `/roast-room ask hormozi ...` gets one answer from one seat.
- `/roast-room --all ...` seats every advisor you have (up to nine).
- `/roast-room board` shows who sits at the table by default and lets you change it.

The room is optional. The council runs the same in Claude Code without it.

## Choose who sits at the table

When you run `/roast-room`, the Chair reads your question and recommends a council from every advisor you have, with one line on why each one fits. You pick:

- **Recommended board**: the five to seven advisors the Chair picked for this question.
- **Default board**: your usual seven.
- **Everyone**: all of them, when you have nine or fewer.
- **Other**: type changes, like "recommended, but add Naval and drop Wickman".

content.readme:
# Animate — procedural animation in any style, for Claude Code

A Claude Code skill that makes short animated videos entirely in code: one `<canvas>`, drawn and scored procedurally, deterministic frame by frame, rendered to MP4 with a headless browser and ffmpeg. Explainers, histories, little stories — in one of the built-in styles, or in a new look matched from your own references.

![the built-in styles](docs/styles.png)

*The built-in styles, each a frame from its demo piece: cut paper, crosshatch ink, riso print, sketchbook, math, pixel, isometric — and the eighth slot: any other look, made from your references.*

## How it works

The skill walks you through a few questions, then makes you approve three cheap things before it spends time animating:

| step | what you see | you decide |
|---|---|---|
| 0. Intake | a handful of questions (subject, formats, voice, the look, hero, your music, your product) and the style gallery | answers, a style, or your references |
| 1. Story check | the format it picked and a numbered beat table, facts web-checked | approve / change beats |
| 2. Look check | 2–4 full-size style frames (for a new look: side-by-side comparisons with your references) | thumbs up per frame |
| 3. Storyboard | every beat as a key frame, with sound and the transition into the next | thumbs up/down by panel number |
| 4. Build | — (animate the approved panels, render, review) | — |
| 5. Delivery | the video plus measured checks: cuts on the beat grid, story arc loudness, hero anchoring, the loudest moment after the silence, narration pace | notes → a revision run |

## Styles

A style is a plug-in: the story grammar, timing, sound, renderer and tools stay the same; the style supplies the drawing kit. A piece picks one in its `piece.json` (`"style": "riso"`).

| style | the look |
|---|---|
| cut paper | torn paper, drop shadows, crayon, patterns, characters with faces |
| crosshatch | sketchy ink that boils on 2s, hatch and pencil shading, warm paper and navy "inside the machine" worlds |
| riso | a three-ink risograph print: halftone screens at their own angles, overprints, misregistration |
| sketchbook | graphite and one accent colour on a sketchbook page, hand lettering |
| math | a manim-style math explainer: black stage, axes and graphs, colour-coded variables, smooth easing |
| pixel | low-resolution eras: drawn at the true resolution, upscaled nearest-neighbour, a bitmap font |
| isometric | precise isometric line art: constant hairlines, white faces hiding what's behind, rounded slabs, one dark accent; light or dark ground |

**Your own look:** give the skill references (a video, stills, a web page) and it follows a procedure — measure the palette, line weight, texture, motion and cut rhythm; draw 1–2 matched frames next to your references (`tools/compare.mjs`); ask for your thumbs up; save it as `styles/<name>/` in your project so every later piece can use it. Reference media stays on your machine.

Each style folder has a `STYLE.md` (its rules, palette, motion habits and a frame checklist), a `kit.js`, a `sample.png` and a small `demo/` piece.

## What's baked in

- **A story grammar** (`grammar/`) — 8 short-form formats (a history is a chronology joined by shape morphs; a mission cuts on the beat; …), the rules every piece follows (one constant, colour means one thing, silence before the payoff and loudest on it, the end is the start changed), and a checklist for what any single frame needs.
- **A kit** (`kit/`) — seeded randomness and a line that boils on 2s; cameras; a renderer with shape-morph transitions (the old world closes in on one object, it morphs into the next world's counterpart, the new world opens out of it) that draws through the style's hooks; a storyboard; a synthesizer and a loudness stage for phone playback.
- **Tools** (`tools/`) — build (assembles one self-contained `index.html` from the piece, the kit and the style), test tiles, stills, storyboard, export (frames → WAV + stems → MP4), review (contact sheets and the measured checks, including text that's cut off or overlapping, and loudness), compare (reference vs frame), a reference measurer, gallery, and a frame-hash check that a kit change left a piece pixel-identical.
- **Craft rules** (`craft.md`) — everything learned building these pieces, from "the sustained pad sets a section's loudness, not the plucks" to "cameras put a world point on a screen point".
- **A voice-over** — it writes the script, gets one take per line from the ElevenLabs connector (or your recording), hears when every word is spoken (locally, with faster-whisper) and times the picture to the words; re-takes re-time the picture automatically.
- **Your own music** — give it a track and it maps the beats (tempo, bars, the big hits, the drops), cuts on the song's beats and puts the payoff on its loudest hit; or it composes a score in code.
